arxiv-1807-01111.title: The inverse xgamma distribution: statistical properties and different methods of estimation
arxiv-1807-01111.creator: Abhimanyu Singh Yadav, Sudhansu S. Maiti, Mahendra Saha, and Arvind Pandey
arxiv-1807-01111.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Abhimanyu Singh Yadav, Sudhansu S. Maiti, Mahendra Saha, and Arvind Pandey. This paper proposed a new probability distribution named as inverse xgamma distribution (IXGD). Different mathematical and statistical properties,viz., reliability characteristics, moments, inverse moments, stochastic ordering and order statistics of the proposed distribution have been derived and discussed.

arxiv-2003-01037.creator: Vincent Lostanlen, Alice Cohen-Hadria, Juan Pablo Bello
arxiv-2003-01037.description: Abstract With the aim of constructing a biologically plausible model of machine listening, we study the representation of a multicomponent stationary signal by a wavelet scattering network. First, we show that renormalizing second-order nodes by their first-order parents gives a simple numerical criterion to assess whether two neighboring components will interfere psychoacoustically.

arxiv-2104-02823.title: Accelerated derivative-free nonlinear least-squares applied to the estimation of Manning coefficients Thanks: This work was supported by FAPESP (grants 2013/07375-0, 2016/01860-1, and 2018/24293-0) and CNPq (grants 302538/2019-4 and 302682/2019-8).

arxiv-2104-02823.description: Abstract A general framework for solving nonlinear least squares problems without the employment of derivatives is proposed in the present paper together with a new general global convergence theory. With the aim to cope with the case in which the number of variables is big (for the standards of derivative-free optimization), two dimension-reduction procedures are introduced.

arxiv-2211-10667.title: Quantum Algorithms for Identifying Hidden Strings with Applications to Matroid Problems
arxiv-2211-10667.creator: Xiaowei Huang, Shihao Zhang and Lvzhou Li
arxiv-2211-10667.description: Abstract In this paper, we explore quantum speedups for the problem, inspired by matroid theory, of identifying a pair of n n -bit binary strings that are promised to have the same number of 1s and differ in exactly two bits, by using the max inner product oracle and the sub-set oracle.

arxiv-2312-00251.title: Memory of shear flow in soft jammed materials
arxiv-2312-00251.creator: H. A. Vinutha 1 ∗, Manon Marchand 2, Marco Caggioni 3, Vishwas V. Vasisht 4, Emanuela Del Gado 1, Veronique Trappe 2 †
arxiv-2312-00251.description: Abstract Cessation of flow in simple yield stress fluids results in a complex stress relaxation process that depends on the preceding flow conditions and leads to finite residual stresses. To assess the microscopic origin of this phenomenon, we combine experiments with largescale computer simulations, exploring the behavior of jammed suspensions of soft repulsive particles.

arxiv-2403-01110.title: GFS-VO: Grid-based Fast and Structural Visual Odometry
arxiv-2403-01110.creator: Zhihe Zhang
arxiv-2403-01110.description: Abstract In the field of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), researchers have always pursued better performance in terms of accuracy and time cost. Traditional algorithms typically rely on fundamental geometric elements in images to establish connections between frames. However, these elements suffer from disadvantages such as uneven distribution and slow extraction.

arxiv-2408-16391.title: TempoKGAT: A Novel Graph Attention Network Approach for Temporal Graph Analysis
arxiv-2408-16391.creator: Lena Sasal, Daniel Busby, Abdenour Hadid
arxiv-2408-16391.description: Abstract Graph neural networks (GNN) have shown significant capabilities in handling structured data, yet their application to dynamic, temporal data remains limited. This paper presents a new type of graph attention network, called TempoKGAT, which combines time-decaying weight and a selective neighbor aggregation mechanism on the spatial domain, which helps uncover latent patterns in the graph data.

arxiv-2409-05026.description: Abstract In signals of opportunity (SOPs)-based positioning utilizing low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites, ephemeris data derived from two-line element files can introduce increasing error over time. To handle the erroneous measurement, an additional base receiver with a known position is often used to compensate for the effect of ephemeris error when positioning the user terminal (UT).

arxiv-2502-13852.title: Minimally sufficient structures for information-feedback policies
arxiv-2502-13852.creator: Basak Sakcak, Vadim K. Weinstein, Kalle G. Timperi, Steven M. LaValle
arxiv-2502-13852.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider robotic tasks which require a desirable outcome to be achieved in the physical world that the robot is embedded in and interacting with. Accomplishing this objective requires designing a filter that maintains a useful representation of the physical world and a policy over the filter states.

arxiv-2511-14981.title: Logit-Based Losses Limit the Effectiveness of Feature Knowledge Distillation
arxiv-2511-14981.creator: Nicholas Cooper, Lijun Chen, Sailesh Dwivedy, Danna Gurari
arxiv-2511-14981.description: Abstract Knowledge distillation (KD) methods can transfer knowledge of a parameter-heavy teacher model to a light-weight student model. The status quo for feature KD methods is to utilize loss functions based on logits (i.e., pre-softmax class scores) and intermediate layer features (i.e., latent representations).

arxiv-2512-03106.title: A portable LED-based diamond magnetometer for outreach and teaching labs
arxiv-2512-03106.description: Abstract We present a compact, low-cost version of an NV center diamond magnetometer which replaces the standard green laser with a high-power LED. This modification improves safety, reduces cost, and allows the green excitation and red photoluminescence to be viewed directly during demonstrations. The device is simple to assemble and suitable for outreach activities and undergraduate laboratories.

pmc-10640581.creator: Dawei Xu, Tianshu Mei, Fei He
pmc-10640581.description: Delayed neurologic sequelae (DNS) is a common complication in patients with carbon monoxide poisoning (COP). A total of 371 COP patients were investigated in retrospective and prospective studies.

pmc-10831389.title: Sex differences in muscle health in simulated micro- and partial-gravity environments in rats
pmc-10831389.creator: Megan E. Rosa-Caldwell, Marie Mortreux, Anna Wadhwa, Ursula B. Kaiser, Dong-Min Sung, Mary L. Bouxsein, Seward B. Rutkove
pmc-10831389.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Skeletal muscle size and strength are important for overall health for astronauts. However, how male and female muscle may respond differently to micro- and partial-gravity environments is not fully understood. The purpose of this study was to determine how biological sex and sex steroid hormones influence the progression of muscle atrophy after long term exposure to micro and partial gravity environments in male and female rats. Male and female Fisher rats (n ​= ​120) underwent either castration/ovariectomy or sham surgeries.

pmc-11395530.title: Evaluation of a Novel Detection Method for Allergen-Specific IgE Antibodies with IgE Receptor Crosslinking Using Rat Food Allergy Model
pmc-11395530.creator: Soichiro Ishii, Yuki Koga, Tomoharu Yokooji, Misaki Kakino, Ryohei Ogino, Takanori Taogoshi, Hiroaki Matsuo

pmc-12457974.title: Inpatient Trauma Care Costs in the US From 2012 to 2021
pmc-12457974.creator: Troy N. Coaston, Nam Yong Cho, Amulya Vadlakonda, Giselle Porter, Saad Mallick, Zeyu Liu, Sara Sakowitz, Peyman Benharash, Galinos Barmparas

pmc-12575861.title: Knowledge and practice of breast self-examination among female undergraduate students in Jigjiga City, Ethiopia

pmc-12575861.description: Breast cancer is the most common type of cancer among women, particularly in low and middle-income countries. Breast self-examination is one of the non-invasive methods of breast cancer screening in which a woman looks at her breast for any abnormal findings.

pmc-12606923.title: Effect of intravenous lidocaine infusion on postoperative pulmonary complications in patients undergoing minimally invasive esophagectomy: a study protocol of double-center, double-blind, randomized controlled trial
pmc-12606923.creator: Fei Wang, Hongwei Zhang, Xilin Peng, Mengxue Liu, Huaiming Wang, Yang Song, Xue Jia, Tao Zhu, Yihao Zhu
pmc-12606923.description: IntroductionEsophageal cancer is the eighth most prevalent malignant tumor in the world and has the sixth highest mortality rate. Postoperative pulmonary complications (PPCs) are one of the most common complications of minimally invasive esophagectomy (MIE). The non-local anesthetic effects of lidocaine have been widely reported, but only a few studies have focused on its effects on lung protection in MIE.

pmc-13249372.title: Empirical Bayes Covariance Decomposition, and a Solution to the Multiple Tuning Problem in Sparse PCA
pmc-13249372.creator: Joonsuk Kang, Matthew Stephens
pmc-13249372.description: Sparse Principal Components Analysis (PCA) has been proposed as a way to improve both interpretability and reliability of PCA. However, use of sparse PCA in practice is hindered by the difficulty of tuning the multiple hyperparameters that control the sparsity of different PCs (the “multiple tuning problem”, MTP). Here we present a solution to the MTP using Empirical Bayes methods.

pmc-13490448.title: Marine fish ranges are expanding and shifting deeper across the European continental shelf
pmc-13490448.creator: Arnaud Auber, Martin P Marzloff, David Mouillot, Kari E Ellingsen, Kirsteen M MacKenzie, Fabien Leprieur, Patrica Belloeil, Matthew J McLean, Daniel G Boyce, Adrián A González Ortiz, Rita Vasconcelos, David M Keith, Eva Maire, Aurore Receveur, Bastien Mourguiart, Camille Albouy
pmc-13490448.description: Understanding how climate change and exploitation affect marine species distribution is key for biodiversity conservation. While warming is typically expected to drive species poleward and into deeper waters, unexpected patterns such as equatorward shifts and shallowing also occur. Fishing pressure may further contract species’ ranges. Yet, the mechanisms underpinning these 3-dimensional range shifts remain largely unresolved.

pmc-13685325.title: Traces of hope in the shadow of war: an exploration of preschoolers’ meaning-making processes of the war concept through visual and verbal narratives
pmc-13685325.creator: Pınar Aksoy
pmc-13685325.description: Despite increasing global exposure of young children to war and conflict, there is limited understanding of how preschool children perceive and make sense of such complex and emotionally charged phenomena. This gap limits educators' ability to recognize children's emotional expressions, support their meaning-making processes, and develop trauma-sensitive, peace-oriented pedagogical practices.
